title: MemoryImportsStageResponse
description: Success returns a MemoryReceipt (§6.10) whose result is a content-free summary: { "import_id": string, "chunks_received": int, "staged_report": { "counts": {...}, "subject_id_map": {...}, "record_id_map": {...}, "candidate_id_map": {...}, "grants_adopted": int, "grants_dropped": int, "verification": { "bundle_digest_ok": bool, "errors": string[] } }? }. Errors use the shared ErrorEnvelope (§14.1) with details.retry_class (§14.2). Codes documented for memory.imports.stage (§7.31): INVALID_INPUT, IMPORT_CONFLICT, NOT_AUTHORIZED, IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Dispatch-layer codes op_unsupported / capability_missing apply at the Connect boundary.
